reason: 该插件的主要用途是提供 JWT 解码与过期判断能力：从 README 与仓库说明可见其唯一公开功能是 `jwt_decode` 工具，用于解析 JWT 的 header/payload 并判断是否过期，因此可归为数据处理类工具型插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件提供 `jwt_decode` 工具，用于解析 JWT 的 header/payload 并检查令牌是否过期，便于快速查看令牌内容。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a `jwt_decode` tool to parse a JWT header and payload and check token expiration for quick token inspection.

capabilities: Provides a `jwt_decode` tool in the plugin bundle.
Parses JWT token header and payload data.
Checks token expiry status from the decoded token fields.

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as JWT decoding, listing a single tool `jwt_decode` for parsing JWT header/payload and checking expiration.
Repository and package description explicitly state: JWT 解码：解析 header/payload，判断是否过期（不验签）.
Package metadata includes the plugin bundle and exposes `lib/index.js` as entry without external service configuration in manifest fields shown.
